svg.title: Two starting points, two paths, opposite final roots

cc:Work.dc:title: Two starting points, two paths, opposite final roots
cc:Work.dc:description: Two paths reach kx=1.5+0.3i. D starts at normal incidence kx=0, passes above the branch point and reaches 0.393−1.146i (outgoing, growing). E starts at the nearest real case kx=1.5 and increases only the imaginary part, reaching −0.393+1.146i (incoming, decaying). These are opposite roots.
